whoItsFor: Developers and hobbyists who want an AI model to operate a real iPhone without a Mac, Xcode, an Apple developer account, or a jailbreak. It suits anyone who can run a server on a Mac or Linux computer and flash a $7 ESP32-S3 board.
useCases: Carrying out a text goal on a real iPhone, such as setting a daily 7:00 AM alarm
Drawing or interacting in canvas-style apps such as Whiteboard
Automating apps and games that have no automation API, since the agent only sees screen pixels

requirements.runtime: Python ≥ 3.10, arduino-cli with ESP32 core 3.x, UxPlay (GStreamer plugins on Linux)
